brief: A variety of well known global landmarks. 15 different landmarks.
complexity_note: Intended easy deck with varied landmark silhouettes; difficulty has not been play-tested.
generation_method: Built-in image_gen tool, one separate call per landmark. Original butterfly illustration supplied as style reference for card 01; card 01 supplied as style reference for cards 02-15.
shared_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE separate square illustrated memory-game card, one unique image per matching pair. Create one well-known world landmark as a polished hand-painted gouache and coloured-pencil travel illustration. Fine warm dark outlines, opaque pigment, subtle hand-drawn pencil texture within the subject, simplified accurate recognizable architecture and bold shapes readable at 100px. Elegant and friendly, not photographic, not 3D, no cartoon faces. Plain uniform opaque warm cream paper background #F8F3E9, no full scene, no sky or horizon line. Soft consistent daylight from upper left. One complete centered landmark or the specifically requested compact landmark group, with a generous 12-14 percent empty cream safe margin on EVERY side; maximum subject width or height 74 percent of the square. Keep the full silhouette including tips and base. Minimal small ground patch only as specified. No words, lettering, numbers, labels, card border, framing box, watermark, logo, flags, decorative motifs, people, unrelated objects, montage, grid or contact sheet. Output one individual square card.
normalization: Untouched generated originals retained. Each full image is uniformly resized to 820x820 and centered inside 1024x1024, extending only the blank background from its edges. No subject cropping or stretching. This guarantees at least 102 pixels of empty added margin on each side.
validation_limits: Visual and package review only. Simplified artistic interpretations, not architectural records. Not imported or play-tested in the game.

cards.title: Eiffel Tower
cards.details: A complete warm bronze-grey Eiffel Tower, seen almost front-on with a slight three-quarter view. Four splayed lattice legs, the broad arch through the base, two broad viewing platforms and the slender pointed antenna. The open lattice must be clear and simplified. A tiny neutral base under its feet only.
